pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with low-frequency, smooth edge gradients. Patches exhibit high variance in spatial area, transitioning from large dorsal blocks to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological network. Junction nodes are wide with high pixel thickness. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible flank and neck regions.
